{
  "description": "XERJ is a Rust-based AI search engine and MCP server providing BM25 full-text, vector, and hybrid search capabilities with an Elasticsearch-compatible API. It indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV, and PDFs for agent memory and RAG.",

      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence_refs": [],
      "notes": "No evidence of diary entry recording functionality. XERJ is a search engine, not a diary management system."
    },
    {
      "name": "Diary Search",
      "capability_id": "CAP.DIARY.SEARCH",
      "coverage": "partial",
      "evidence_status": "inferred",
      "confidence": 0.6,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@50e4ffde",
        "engine/Cargo.toml@50e4ffde"
      ],
      "notes": "XERJ provides general-purpose search (BM25, vector, hybrid) which could technically be used to search diary entries if indexed. However, it lacks specific diary domain features like unit/track/location linking or structured diary entry schemas."

  "dependencies": [
    "Rust 1.94 (trixie)",
    "Debian trixie-slim (glibc 2.41)",
    "Optional neural embedder (~90 MB)"
  ],
  "runtime": [
    "Linux container available",
    "Single binary deployment"
  ],
  "deployment_constraints": [
    "Requires Linux (Debian trixie-slim for glibc compatibility)",
    "Binds to loopback by default; container requires explicit 0.0.0.0 binding",
    "Optional GPU not required but neural embedder available as opt-in"
  ],
  "maturity": "developing",
  "adaptation_hours_estimate": 40,
  "adaptation_confidence": "low",
  "adaptation_assumptions": [
    "Assumes diary entries can be indexed as standard documents in XERJ's search index",
    "Assumes unit/track/location metadata can be stored as custom fields in the index schema",
    "Assumes HTTPS POST submission can be handled via XERJ's existing ingestion pipeline or a wrapper service"
  ],
  "known_gaps": [
    "No native diary entry data model or schema",
    "No support for linking entries to units, tracks, or map locations as first-class relationships",
    "No diary-specific search filters or faceting beyond generic XERJ search capabilities",
    "No built-in HTTPS POST endpoint specifically for diary submission (requires external wrapper)"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "License: Apache-2.0 is permissive but requires attribution",
    "Maturity: Release candidate (rc.102) indicates ongoing development; API stability not guaranteed",
    "Maintenance: Active project with recent commits, but diary-specific adaptation is untested"
  ],
  "evidence": [

    },
    {
      "claim": "MCP server integration is supported",
      "source_ref": "dsh/package.json@50e4ffde",
      "verified": false
    }
  ]
